description: This Java source file defines the custom exception class GatewayPlaceholderNotResolvableException, which indicates that a request contains an unresolved placeholder. It includes static methods to build exception instances for unknown placeholders and non-resolvable inputs, as well as a method to reconstruct the exception from JSON. The class extends DittoRuntimeException and implements GatewayException, and contains an inner Builder class for constructing instances with specific parameters.

classes.name: GatewayPlaceholderNotResolvableException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException, representing an exception for unresolved placeholders in requests.

classes.name: GatewayPlaceholderNotResolvableException.Builder
classes.description: Inner static thread-unsafe builder class for constructing instances of GatewayPlaceholderNotResolvableException with specific details, supporting a fluent API.

methods.name: newUnknownPlaceholderBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder initialized for an exception indicating an unknown placeholder, with details about the placeholder and supported placeholders.

methods.name: newNotResolvableInputBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for an exception indicating an input contains non-resolvable placeholders.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Reconstructs the exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with provided DittoHeaders, copying existing message, description, cause, and href.
